mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with semaglutide's GLP-1 effects on appetite and glucose metabolism may potentiate hypoglycemia risk and serotonergic effects, while semaglutide's gastric effects may alter tranylcypromine absorption.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if necessary, monitor blood glucose closely, educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms, and consider alternative antidepressant with lower serotonergic interaction potential.
